content:
Looking for new iPhone and iPad games to play? The App Store has plenty of games with no ads and no in-app purchases.

Apple Arcade is a subscription service suitable for the whole family, but it's not the only option. If you're a Netflix subscriber, you can already access some great iPhone and iPad games.

Your Netflix subscription already includes a large collection of iPhone and iPad games

Now, every Netflix subscription plan includes a whole bunch of mobile and TV games.

Including the cheapest "Standard with ads" plan at US$8.99 per month.

Regardless of which Netflix plan you've chosen, you can play mobile and TV games with no ads, no in-app purchases, and no extra fees.

On the TV gaming side, Netflix offers a dedicated iPhone and iPad app called Netflix Game Controller.

This app can turn your phone or tablet into an input device, working with supported Netflix smart TV apps for gaming. If you want to enhance your mobile gaming experience, a proper iPhone-specific controller would be a better choice.

Netflix also has another iPhone and iPad app called Netflix Playground, designed for kids, offering mini-games. Additionally, there's Netflix Puzzled: Logic Games (no subscription required) and Netflix Stories.

Beyond these, there are over 80 iPhone and iPad games. You can download them from the App Store and sign in with your Netflix email and password to play.
